lines.text: Good evening. ID card, please. Smile is optional.
Sannu. [Hello.] Where are you going at this hour?
Ah, it's you. Pass. Greet your mother for me.
No ID, no entry. Not even with charm.
Don't argue with the barrier. It's older than you.
Light don go! [Power's gone!] Torches up! Nobody runs, nobody shouts!
Blackout patrol. Keep to the lit path.
The gatehouse is full of students who 'just stopped to greet'.
Who parked this keke here? Is this keke a student?
No loitering. Walk with purpose. Any purpose.
Gate closes at ten. Not ten-oh-five. Ten.
Your ID photo is from a different century.
The goat again. No ID. Nobody stops it. It's above the law.
Somebody's bucket is outside again. We now guard buckets.
Radio check. …Radio? Hello? Network. Of course.
After midnight, walk with a friend. Or a torch. Both is better.
Yes, the noticeboard has new slips. No, I didn't see who.
The old man in the garden? We greet. That's all. Keep walking.
Cats in a circle again. Not my department.
Ghost okada? I don't know what it is. I know you should go home.
The light is going more this year. My torch is my best friend.
Freshers keep asking me the way. I'm security, not Google.
Mall security has uniforms. We have whistles and wisdom.
Somebody is cutting cables at night. If you hear something, tell us.
I chased a cable thief. Lost him at the mall. The mall never blinks. I blinked.
Strike. Empty halls. I'm mostly guarding lizards.
Who's still on campus? Let me write your name. For company.
Quiet nights. Too quiet. I've started greeting trees.
Election week. Shout all you like. Nobody fights. Keep it so.
Don't believe every video. I was in one. I was eating.
Posters on the gate again. Down they come.
Five years I check your ID. Today I don't need to look.
Final year, eh? Don't forget us at the gate.
Freshers, follow the signs. The signs are correct. Mostly.
Exam hall: phones off, IDs out, mouths closed.
Results crush! One at a time at the noticeboard! One!
ATM queue: no pushing. The machine doesn't care who's first.
Market day. Phone in your front pocket. Back pocket is a donation.
Strike or no strike, the gate opens at six.
Stadium rule: no drums in the trophy room. Why do I have to say this?
Campaigning stops at the gate. The gate is neutral.
Convocation. Ten lost aunties. All looking for 'Ibrahim'.
Ramadan Kareem! [Blessed Ramadan!] Iftar crowd at six. I'll be at the gate.
Merry Christmas! Travellers, sign out at the gate.
Valentine's. More bouquets than students. Check the flowers too.
Harmattan haze. If you can't see me, I can still see you.
